artifacts.summary: Grounds measure-eager-context.sh design: generate_claudemd() assembly algorithm (merge.lua:768-879), why deploy-headless.sh must not be invoked (regeneration-is-manual-only.md single-sanctioned-caller policy), the paths:-frontmatter glob-match correction from the prior 054 task's handoff, provenance of the 70,160B/17,540-token baseline, and the existing (insufficient) measure-eager-surface.sh prior art.

memory_candidates.content: Repo policy: agent-system/extensions/core/context/patterns/regeneration-is-manual-only.md licenses exactly ONE automated caller of scripts/deploy-headless.sh (skill-orchestrate's Stage MT-3 step 7). Any new script that needs to know what a regenerate would produce must model/replicate the assembly logic (merge.lua's generate_claudemd: read .claude-extensions.json active+sorted extensions, core first, concatenate each extension's manifest.json .merge_targets.claudemd.source fragment with a core/templates/claudemd-header.md prefix, joined by blank lines) rather than shelling out to deploy-headless.sh, even against a scratch copy.

A rule's paths: frontmatter gates when Claude Code's harness injects it eagerly, independent of the curated @-import list. Checking only 'absent or paths: "**/*"' undercounts the eager rule set by ~71%: rules gated on specs/**/* or .claude/**/* (e.g. git-workflow.md, artifact-formats.md, state-management.md in this repo) ALSO load eagerly for any session touching those paths, which is nearly every session. Any eager-context measurement tool must glob-match each rule's paths: value against a representative touched-path set (at minimum specs/** and .claude/**), not just check for absent/universal frontmatter.
